correctness.rationale: In the Laurent ONB e_n=z^n/sqrt(1+beta Q^n), M_z has squared weights (1+beta Q^(n+1))/(1+beta Q^n), so C=M* M-MM* is diagonal with positive eigenvalues (1-Q)^2 beta Q^(n-1)/[(1+beta Q^(n-1))(1+beta Q^n)]. Both tails decay geometrically, giving compact injective C in every Schatten S_p (p>0) and trace telescoping to 1-Q. Equality of F_Q(t) and F_Q(s) factors as (t-s)(1-Qts)=0, hence all collisions occur iff beta=q^k; even k all eigenvalues double, odd k exactly peak simple and others double. Unimodal F_Q maximizes at t=1/q, with sharp norm between (1-Q)^2/(2(1+Q)) for even k and (1-q)^2 for odd k. The prior kernel-zero criterion at beta=q^(2j+1) coincides with the norm peak. Exact rational tests independently checked eigenvalue-vs-shift differences, reflection pairs, extrema for 3 rational q and k=-5..5.
